tasks.title: Fix remaining npm vulnerabilities in web app

tasks.details:
## Remaining npm Vulnerabilities

| Package | Severity | Current | Issue |
|---------|----------|---------|-------|

| `next` | Moderate | 16.1.5 | Authorization bypass in auth redirects |

1. **jspdf**: Check for updates from maintainer, or consider:
   - Switching to alternative PDF library (pdf-lib, pdfmake)
   - Sanitizing HTML input before passing to html() method

   - Latest version 3.3.4 is installed
   - Advisory says versions <=3.4.1 are vulnerable
   - May need to wait for advisory correction or use override

## Files to Modify
- `apps/web/package.json` - overrides section
- `apps/api/pyproject.toml` if switching PDF library

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] npm audit shows 0 vulnerabilities OR
- [ ] All remaining vulnerabilities have documented workarounds/mitigations
